programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid 1 rectangle is the object; everything else outside it gives its orientation.
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in ones), max(r for r,c in ones)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in ones), max(c for r,c in ones)
    obj = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    oh, ow = len(obj), len(obj[0])
    outside = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != 0 and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    er0, er1 = min(r for r,c,v in outside), max(r for r,c,v in outside)
    ec0, ec1 = min(c for r,c,v in outside), max(c for r,c,v in outside)
    # Each outside marker identifies the corresponding corner in the transformed rectangle.
    ops = [
        (lambda r,c:(r,c)),
        (lambda r,c:(r,ow-1-c)),
        (lambda r,c:(oh-1-r,c)),
        (lambda r,c:(oh-1-r,ow-1-c)),
        (lambda r,c:(c,r)),
        (lambda r,c:(ow-1-c,oh-1-r)),
        (lambda r,c:(c,oh-1-r)),
        (lambda r,c:(ow-1-c,r)),
    ]
    for op in ops:
        coords = [[op(r,c) for c in range(ow)] for r in range(oh)]
        th = max(x for row in coords for x,y in row)+1
        tw = max(y for row in coords for x,y in row)+1
        out = [[0]*tw for _ in range(th)]
        for r in range(oh):
            for c in range(ow):
                x,y=op(r,c); out[x][y]=obj[r][c]
        matches = True
        for r,c,color in outside:
            rr = 0 if r == er0 else th-1
            cc = 0 if c == ec0 else tw-1
            positions=[(a,b) for a in range(th) for b in range(tw) if out[a][b]==color]
            if len(positions) != 1 or positions[0] != (rr,cc):
                matches=False; break
        if matches:
            return out
    # The marker-defined transform is among the dihedral symmetries; this is a safe default.
    return obj
'''

print(p, code)
